run_pipeline_image_edit: run the StableDiffusionXLInstructPix2PixPipeline to edit an image using a text instruction prompt
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text encoder hidden states for the SDXL pipeline
prepare_image_latents: prepare and encode an input image into VAE latent space for the SDXL pipeline
load_lora_weights: load LoRA weights into the StableDiffusionXLInstructPix2PixPipeline for customized image editing
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale classifier-free guidance noise predictions to fix overexposure in generated images
